def config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Return the value for key in name=value lines of text, or "" when the key is absent.

    The first line whose name matches key wins. Blank lines and lines
    without "=" are skipped. Names and values are stripped of surrounding
    whitespace.
    """
    pre key != ""
    post out.count("\n") == 0
    ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
    ex config_value("a = x=y\n", "a") == "x=y"
    ex config_value("a=1", "z") == ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if line == "":
            continue
        name, sep, value = line.partition("=")
        if sep == "":
            continue
        if name.strip() == key:
            return value.strip()
    return ""
